QuestInfo.name: Nero's Training 1
QuestInfo.0: #bNero#k looks excited. Find out what she wants you to do.
QuestInfo.1: Your first target is the #bEvil Eye#k. Hunt down #b50#k and collect #b10 tails#k. This sounds more like hunting for food than training, but whatever.\r\n\r\n#bWhere Trees Dance#k is the closest place to go.
QuestInfo.2: That's it for Evil Eye hunting. You do feel a bit stronger. See if #bNero#k has more training for you.
